newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-ROSENBORG'S HJELDE SET FOR BARI SAYS PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROSENBORG'S HJELDE SET FOR BARI SAYS PAPER.

text.p: Rosenborg Trondheim defender Jon Olav Hjelde is set to sign for Italy's newly-promoted serie A club Bari, Norwegian daily Adresseavisen said on Tuesday.
Adresseavisen said Bari was willing to pay Norway's top club between two and three million crowns ($268,000 and $403,000) to free Hjelde three months before his contract is up.
It said Hjelde had apparently agreed a three-year contract with Bari, including an annual salary of between four and five million crowns.
"I like it at Rosenborg and would not move abroad for any price," Hjelde told Adresseavisen. "But at the same time it is tempting to try something new."
